reviewNotes: Reviewed all 445 distinct exported speech keys from 150 cards against data/conjugation-drill.json source furigana, conjugation rules and accepted hiragana answers before Nova generation. Sentence/cloze question prompts use speed 1.0. Standalone conjugated forms and short base-to-conjugation explanation pairs use 0.85; these explanation pairs are not full sentences. Topic/contrast は -> わ selected by exact key and occurrence, including では as a discourse marker. Lexical はなす/はなし, はやい/はやく/はやめ, はれ, はいった/はいって/はいれる/はいろう, はこ, はなび, はじめて, ごはん, はいたつ, しはらい and はっそう preserved. In あしたはっそう, はっそう is lexical 発送, not topic は. Every を is an object particle -> お. No directional へ occurs; lexical へんこう and へや retained. Corrected source 話(はなし)させる input to はなさせる using rule す -> さ + せる and accepted はなさせる. Corrected 来(き)させる and its explanation input to こさせる, following くる -> こさせる rule and accepted こさせる. All other standalone answer readings checked against accepted hiragana forms. Short arrow explanation pairs use a spoken pause (、) while display arrows and lookup keys are unchanged. Katakana converted to hiragana with long vowels/gemination preserved. Final punctuation added to fragments. Text review only; audible articulation and pitch accent not verified.
